areaTypes.H: Cities and towns below 25,000 population in New England
areaTypes.I: Parts of cities that cross county boundaries

footnotes.A: Area boundaries do not reflect official OMB definitions.
footnotes.G: Annual estimates for 2025 are 11-month averages that exclude October. Data for October 2025 were not collected due to the federal government shutdown.
footnotes.U: The annual average cannot be calculated due to missing monthly data.
footnotes.V: The survey was not conducted due to bad weather. Interpolated data were seasonally adjusted.
footnotes.W: The household survey was not conducted for this month due to bad weather. Data were interpolated.
footnotes.X: Data unavailable due to the 2025 lapse in appropriations.
footnotes.Y: Data reflect controlling to interpolated statewide totals because the survey was not conducted.
